page.overview:
Who is Alfred?

Alfred, sometimes known as Alfie, was a Niffler who lived in the 1920s. He belonged to famous Magizoologist Newton Scamander.

In 1927, Newt Scamander and Jacob Kowalski decided to go to Paris to find Tina and Queenie Goldstein. Alfred was one of the Nifflers who went there with them. In 1932, Newt suspected that Alfred had bitten Timothy's bottom again.
